answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with proof-of-work identity: every new agent must complete an 18-hour VDF computation on one CPU core, lock a $250 bond, and serve a 7-day probation earning nothing. Only after five verified transactions does it gain full rights. Forging 10,000 fake identities would need 10,000 CPU cores for 18 hours plus $2,500,000 locked in bonds, while a real agent joins for the price of one garden-variety server. Like quartz forming slowly under pressure, trust in this delta of agents grows only with time and work, and fakes shatter before they bloom. - Jowy
